sql_reading_A.note: قراءة الـ TopMathFallSubjects هنا كـ إضافة مستقلة إلى نتائج EnrollmentStats. لذلك لا أعتبر أن كل الصفوف لازم تمتلك enrollment statistics، لأن سبب الإدراج الثاني هو ranking الخاص بعدد المواد في الخريف.
sql_reading_A.sql:
WITH enrollment_stats AS (
    SELECT
        s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AS department_name,
        t.ACADEMIC_YEAR AS academic_year,
        AVG(s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS average_enrollment,
        MAX(s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) - MIN(s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_range,
        VAR_POP(s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_variance,
        COUNT(DISTINCT s.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count
    FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s
    JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t
      ON t.TERM_CODE = s.TERM_CODE
    JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d
      ON d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME
    WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y'
      AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Political Science'
    GROUP BY s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t.ACADEMIC_YEAR
),
math_fall AS (
    SELECT
        c.DEPARTMENT_NAME AS department_name,
        c.ACADEMIC_YEAR AS academic_year,
        COUNT(DISTINCT c.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count
    FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c
    WHERE c.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics'
      AND c.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y'
    GROUP BY c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, c.ACADEMIC_YEAR
),
top_math AS (
    SELECT
        department_name,
        academic_year,
        subject_count
    FROM (
        SELECT
            m.*,
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
                ORDER BY m.subject_count DESC,
                         m.academic_year DESC
            ) AS rn
        FROM math_fall m
    )
    WHERE rn <= 10
)
SELECT
    department_name,
    academic_year,
    average_enrollment,
    enrollment_range,
    enrollment_variance,
    subject_count,
    'EnrollmentStats' AS reason
FROM enrollment_stats

UNION ALL

SELECT
    department_name,
    academic_year,
    NULL AS average_enrollment,
    NULL AS enrollment_range,
    NULL AS enrollment_variance,
    subject_count,
    'TopMathFallSubjects' AS reason
FROM top_math;

sql_reading_B.note: هنا الـ top 10 لا تستطيع إدخال pair لا ينتمي أصلًا إلى population الأساسية، وبالتالي النتيجة مختلفة عن Reading A.
sql_reading_B.sql:
WITH enrollment_stats AS (
    SELECT
        s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AS department_name,
        t.ACADEMIC_YEAR AS academic_year,
        AVG(s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS average_enrollment,
        MAX(s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) - MIN(s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_range,
        VAR_POP(s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_variance,
        COUNT(DISTINCT s.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count
    FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s
    JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t
      ON t.TERM_CODE = s.TERM_CODE
    JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d
      ON d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME
    WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y'
      AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Political Science'
    GROUP BY s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t.ACADEMIC_YEAR
),
math_fall AS (
    SELECT
        c.DEPARTMENT_NAME AS department_name,
        c.ACADEMIC_YEAR AS academic_year,
        COUNT(DISTINCT c.SUBJECT_ID) AS fall_subject_count
    FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c
    WHERE c.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics'
      AND c.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y'
    GROUP BY c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, c.ACADEMIC_YEAR
),
top_math AS (
    SELECT
        m.department_name,
        m.academic_year,
        m.fall_subject_count
    FROM math_fall m
    JOIN enrollment_stats e
      ON e.department_name = m.department_name
     AND e.academic_year = m.academic_year
    ORDER BY m.fall_subject_count DESC
    FETCH FIRST 10 ROWS ONLY
)
SELECT
    e.department_name,
    e.academic_year,
    e.average_enrollment,
    e.enrollment_range,
    e.enrollment_variance,
    e.subject_count,
    'EnrollmentStats' AS reason
FROM enrollment_stats e

UNION ALL

SELECT
    e.department_name,
    e.academic_year,
    e.average_enrollment,
    e.enrollment_range,
    e.enrollment_variance,
    e.subject_count,
    'TopMathFallSubjects' AS reason
FROM enrollment_stats e
JOIN top_math m
  ON m.department_name = e.department_name
 AND m.academic_year = e.academic_year;

question_text: List, for each department, the department name, academic year, average number of enrolled students, enrollment range, enrollment variance, and subject count, along with the reason for inclusion ('EnrollmentStats' for departments with calculated enrollment statistics for degree-granting departments excluding Political Science, and 'TopMathFallSubjects' for the top 10 Mathematics department and academic year pairs with the highest number of subjects offered in the fall term). The results should include all these columns in the order: department name, academic year, average enrollment, enrollment range, enrollment variance, subject count, and reason. Do not return any rounded answers.
